name: Mantis BT
description: MantisBT (Mantis Bug Tracker) is an open-source issue tracker that provides a simple and effective solution for managing software development tasks and bugs. This would be a great complement to Gitea and Jenkins, creating a complete development and CI/CD ecosystem.

notes.text: Complet theinstallation script and follow the MantisBT install/upgrade guide to finish configuration. DB credentials saved in ~/mantisbt.creds
This installation uses PostgreSQL as the default database.
